review_candidates.title: Senior Information Technology Specialist
review_candidates.description_excerpt: We are looking for an IT Specialist to manage and maintain our day-to-day IT operations across the head office and retail branches, ensuring reliable systems, seamless connectivity, and responsive technical support for our teams. This role is ideal for a proactive and hands-on IT professional with strong troubleshooting skills, experience in IT operations, and the ability to manage technical requirements across multiple locations while ensuring minimal disruption to business operations. review_candidates.requirements_excerpt: This role is ideal for a proactive and hands-on IT professional with strong troubleshooting skills, experience in IT operations, and the ability to manage technical requirements across multiple locations while ensuring minimal disruption to business operations. -Manage IT requirements for employee onboarding and offboarding, including device preparation, email creation, system access, and asset recovery. 3–5 years of experience in IT Support or IT Operations. If you're a hands-on IT professional who enjoys solving problems, taking ownership, and ensuring smooth day-to-day operations, we'd love to hear from you.
